title: The Company State
text: The nation incorporates. Elections become shareholder meetings, and the police answer to the board. You win, and the ballot is quietly delisted.

title: The Sponsored Republic
text: Every institution now carries a logo. The constitution is a terms-of-service nobody read, and you own the platform it runs on.

title: The Benevolent Monopoly
text: You give the people everything they need — from a single supplier they cannot leave. Kindness, metered and billed monthly.

title: The Iron Ledger
text: Order is enforced, and order is profitable. The convoys run on time because the alternative is bankruptcy, or worse.

title: The Permanent Rally
text: The crowd never goes home. Devotion is broadcast around the clock, and dissent simply fails to trend into existence.

title: The Righteous Fist
text: You rule for the people's own good, and the people who disagree are, by definition, enemies of the good. The cause forgives everything.

title: The Attention Economy
text: Truth is whatever holds the feed longest. Reality is a subscription, and you have raised the price of looking away.

title: The Spectacle Regime
text: Governance is a season finale, forever. The enemies are cast, the villains recast, and the audience mistakes the applause for a vote.

title: The Cult of Sincerity
text: You believe every word, and so do they. Doubt is a personal failing now, and the sermon never, ever ends.

title: The Charity Sovereign
text: No one is poor; everyone is a beneficiary. You decide who deserves, and gratitude is the only currency that still trades freely.

title: The Purified State
text: The dream is achieved, and now it must be protected — from compromise, from difference, from anyone insufficiently pure of heart.

title: The Feel-Good Autocracy
text: Everyone is uplifted, hourly, whether they like it or not. Hope is compulsory, and the exits have been repainted as murals.
